# E-Clearby Research Consulting
Advisory-only PhD, Master's, and research paper guidance in Pune, India. 
We offer topic consultation, proposal development, literature review, methodology, data analysis (SPSS, NVivo, AMOS), and thesis defence preparation.

## Key Principles
- Academic Integrity is Non-Negotiable
- Scholars Maintain Full Authorship
- Advisory & Coaching Role Only
